verifications.evidence: R1: 'The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and Nasdaq are closed Good Friday, April 3, 2026.'; R4: 'The Nasdaq and New York Stock Exchange will close on Friday'; R5: 'U.S. stock markets, including the Nasdaq and the New York Stock Exchange, will be closed on Friday, April 3'; R7: 'The stock markets on New York Stock Exchange and the Nasdaq are closed for trading on Good Friday, April 3, 2026.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly state NYSE and Nasdaq are closed on April 3, 2026, for Good Friday.
